newsitem.title: FRANCE: Greenpeace demonstrates against nuclear shipment.
newsitem.headline: Greenpeace demonstrates against nuclear shipment.

text.p: Some 20 Greenpeace members demonstrated by the gates of the northern French port of Cherbourg on Sunday, protesting against a shipment of processed nuclear waste about to leave for Japan.

They said they would stay at least until the arrival, expected during the night, of the "Pacific Teal," due to leave on Monday for Japan with waste which initially came from Japan and was processed at a nearby French nuclear plant.

Previous shipments to Japan and elsewhere have caused an outcry among anti-nuclear militants. Thousands of protesters battled police in Germany when one such shipment from France arrived there last May.
